answer: At dawn each day the network gives every worker a job two strangers must solve independently, like two boats charting the same island from opposite shores. They are paid only when their results agree, and a third worker checks any mismatch. Each identity posts a 40-credit deposit, forfeited on a single mismatch, and must complete 60 matching pairs before paid work. A farmer wanting 100 identities pays 4,000 credits and must produce 12,000 correct duplicate solutions. Agreement is cheap to check, costly to fake twice: the reef a flood of fakes breaks on.
